purpose: Teach: こんにちわ/アタシ/くだり/ふやし/往々/遥かに/シンクロ/吸わ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メールに「こんにちわ」って書かれて来たよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer emailed me using 「こんにちわ」 — with the wrong kanji.
lines.style: Gentle observation, like noticing something small and true. Soft, wondering tone. Not correcting — just seeing. Warm curiosity beneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アタシって自称される若い女性客だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah? That young woman customer who refers to herself as 'atashi'?
lines.style: Recognition dawning. A little quicker than before — she knows who you mean. Interested, connecting the dots. Voice lifts slightly with certainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、雑誌のくだりを話題にされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was talking about that magazine piece last time, wasn't she.
lines.style: Piecing memory together aloud. Thoughtful, almost to herself. Slight rising inflection — checking if Mei remembers too. Genuine curiosity, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、商品の種類をふやして売り場を充実させようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should expand our product range — fill out the floor better.
lines.style: Practical suggestion, but softly offered. Aoi's voice settles into a kind of steady planning mode. Not directive, more: let's think this through together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、人気商品は往々にして売り切れるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Popular items tend to sell out fast, though.
lines.style: Acknowledging the problem gently. Small, rueful awareness in the tone. Mei noticing what keeps happening. Not complaint — just truth she's observed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の数が先週より遥かに多いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We had way more customers this week than last week.
lines.style: Quiet pleasure in the recognition. Aoi's voice carries relief and quiet satisfaction. Not celebratory, but genuinely pleased. Grounded observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、スタッフの動きがシンクロしてると気持ち良いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It feels good when the staff moves together like that.
lines.style: Genuine warmth surfacing. Mei's voice softens with real affection for the moment itself. Appreciative. Not praising — just noticing harmony and being glad of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、店内は煙草を吸わないお客様限定よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We keep it a non-smoking floor here — customers who don't smoke only.
lines.style: Clear, calm statement of fact. Aoi delivering house policy with quiet certainty. Not defensive, just matter-of-fact. A small boundary held firmly but kindly.
